question:
The following pie chart shows the percentage-wise distribution of the number of people of various occupation from different states of India.

Which of the given options would be the angle at the centre of the pie chart for the Engineer segment?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/465310a93861d0e41c441ed7bfb5a54b33a5649d58a3c680407a7dba0269914d.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8bd3d20a638cf8e23d7cea68a3b0ee6008dd1caff8abc0f5250f2195d91a940f.png]
solution:
**Given:**

The following pie chart shows the percentage-wise distribution of the number of people of various occupations from different states of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8bd3d20a638cf8e23d7cea68a3b0ee6008dd1caff8abc0f5250f2195d91a940f.png] 

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

30% of total pie chart are engineers

⇒ 30% of 360° = Engineers

⇒ Engineers = 30% × 360° 

⇒ Engineers = 0.30 × 360° = 108° 

**∴ The angle at the center of the pie chart for the Engineer segment is 108°.**
